gre_general.value: The chemical engineering doctorate does not require the GRE General Test.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test scores are not required.

deadline.value: Fall 2027 PhD applications are due December 15, 2026; the official table prints no year.

gre_subject.value: The official programme page states no subject GRE rule.

supervisor.value: The official programme page states no rule on needing a supervisor's agreement before admission.

funding.value: The School of Engineering says full-time PhD students often receive a tuition scholarship; the page does not say that most are funded.

also.quote: Full-time PhD students within the School of Engineering often receive a tuition scholarship.

entry_route.value: The official programme page does not say whether a bachelor's or a master's is needed.

notes: The Biotechnology Engineering doctorate is a separate School of Engineering PhD (see its GSAS page); its values are not used here. Entry route is not stated: the page says applicants 'are generally expected to have a prior degree in chemical engineering', which does not settle bachelor's vs master's.
